newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate end down on prepayment news.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate end down on prepayment news.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 40 basis points at 19.60 percent on Tuesday in response to positive domestic and international economic news, dealers said.
"The market was calm to begin with, after U.S. inflation figures were released," a trader said, referring to U.S. consumer price data announced shortly before the market opened.
Mexico's Finance Ministry then announced during early trade that it would prepay $6 billion in floating rate notes, issued August 5, 1997.
